parameters.query:
WITH matches AS (
 SELECT text,metadata,1-(embedding OPERATOR(extensions.<=>) $3::extensions.vector(3072)) AS score
 FROM public.internship_role_chunks
 WHERE role_id=$1 AND metadata->>'dataset'='internship_roles'
   AND metadata->>'source_version'=$2::text AND metadata->>'catalog_version'=$2::text
   AND metadata->>'embedding_model'='models/gemini-embedding-001'
 ORDER BY embedding OPERATOR(extensions.<=>) $3::extensions.vector(3072),id LIMIT 3
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('ok',count(*)>0,'role_id',$1::text,'source_version',$2::integer,
  'documents',coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('text',text,'metadata',metadata,'score',score)),'[]'::jsonb)) AS result
FROM matches;
